_comment: pi.dev auth file — deploy to ~/.pi/agent/auth.json (chmod 0600), replacing sk-REPLACE-ME with the real virtual key. CORRECTED 2026-09-02 (lai-30): pi does NOT interpolate environment variables in this file. The previous version stored the literal string "$LITELLM_API_KEY" on the strength of a claim that pi expanded it at runtime; it does not — pi sends whatever string is here verbatim as the bearer token, so LiteLLM answered 401 ("Received=$LIT****_KEY, expected to start with 'sk-'") and pi had been non-functional against this gateway since 2026-07-29. Removing auth.json does not help either: pi then sends models.json's apiKey field verbatim (401 "Received=reso****json"). A real key must be written here. Use the least-privilege coding key (vault ai_stack.litellm_coding_key = LiteLLM alias coding-agents, scoped q38+utility) — NOT an unrestricted key. auth.json credentials take priority over env and are what make the custom 'litellm' provider's models appear in pi's /model picker (and Orca's).
